<STBG 3,0><BGM 0,0,502><TALK 5><NAME 10><CHAR 5,1,7,0,8><CV 5,1>Foh foh foh!
What brings you here?

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,1,1,2,3><CV 1,5>I found something remarkable,
so I came to report it!

This is a chalice.
It seems made of shark scales.

And this jagged rim —
this is a shark's tooth.

But this gold —
not paint, it is its natural colour.

A golden shark...!
Did such things exist in ancient times!

<CV 5,4>Yes, it matches the tablet's wording.
This is unmistakably a relic.

I'll look into it in more detail.
Drop by again if you're nearby.

<CHAR 1,0,1,0,0><CV 1,21>And yet, the Dronneko gang!
I just cannot forgive them!

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,1,7><CV 1,35>Those people called the Dronneko gang
keep getting in the way of exploration.
